persons.name: Śivanārāyaṇa
persons.evidence: ivāhārayā śivanārāyaṇācāryyana thva ghaṃtha coya madhuṃko

persons.name: Yaśodhara
persons.evidence: vaṃlānihma gṛha nivāsita vipra śrījaśodharana saṃpūrṇa yāṅana coyā dina juro

persons.name: Yoganarendramalla
persons.evidence: erayā śrī joganarendra malla thākura esa bijyācakāva

persons.name: Bhūpālendramalla
persons.evidence: śrī bhūpārendra malla thākulana thva kāryya yāka juro

notes: The colophon contains two dates: (1) NS 820 vaiśākha kṛṣṇa 13 Sunday, recording the staging of the play (pyākhana pidaṅa dina) by King Bhūpālendramalla of Kathmandu (Yayā) attended by King Yoganarendramalla of Patan (Erayā/Yelayā) and the king of Bhaktapur (Khwapa / ṣopo); and (2) NS 740 vaiśākha śukla 13 Monday, the actual date of completion of the copying by vipra Yaśodhara after Śivanārāyaṇācārya of Ivāhāra left it unfinished.
